treatment_summary.value: Intensive immunosuppression with prednisolone, sirolimus, tacrolimus, infliximab or rituximab (clinical course refractory); recombinant granulocyte colony stimulating factor supporting neutrophils pretransplant; haematopoietic stem cell transplantation; 21 months post-transplant thriving off all immunosuppressive medication with complete remission of autoimmune disease (except diabetes); subcutaneous immunoglobulin supplementation post-HSCT.

disease_label_as_stated.value: Early-onset autoimmune disease due to a heterozygous loss-of-function mutation in TNFAIP3 (A20); complex autoimmunity; case described as expanding the clinical spectrum of A20 haploinsufficiency

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Whole exome sequencing of peripheral blood genomic DNA (Illumina MiSeq) with Ingenuity Variant Analysis filtering, confirmed by capillary (Sanger) sequencing; pathogenic variants in STAT3 and FOXP3 excluded; functional studies in patient dermal fibroblasts

functional_evidence_statement.value: Reduced basal and TNF-alpha-induced A20 protein in patient versus control dermal fibroblasts (immunoblot, N-terminal antibody); exaggerated and prolonged phosphorylation of NF-kB pathway components after TNF-alpha stimulation; RNA-seq showed a significant global increase in range and magnitude of TNF-alpha-stimulated differential gene expression; enhanced IL-6 protein by ELISA (p=0.0015). Inflammasome activation not tested (no leucocyte material).

pathogenicity_as_stated_by_authors.value: heterozygous loss-of-function mutation; molecular consequences 'indistinguishable from reported pathogenic A20 mutations'; absent from ExAc/dbSNP

hpo_label_candidate.value: Decreased proportion of naive T cells
